Class TransactionDTO

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.dto.TransactionDTO
public class TransactionDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing transaction information. Used to transfer transaction data between layers without exposing the domain model. Contains complete transaction details including customer information, financial breakdown, loyalty points, and purchased items.
